mapper.select: SELECT o.* FROM topp_order o JOIN tcomm_task t ON t.id_ = o.task_id WHERE o.order_type = 'support_order'

SELECT
concat(1,to2.id_,b.warnUserId) work_order_code,
concat(1,to2.id_,IFNULL(md.id_, '0000036')) work_order_code,
case to2.status_ when 'end' then 2 else 4 end work_order_status, concat(to2.cust_name, sc.remark_) work_order_name, DATE_FORMAT(to2.create_time ,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') work_order_time, (select COUNTY_ID from dwd_rep_sys_person_d where oa_user_name=UPPER(su.oa_account) limit 1) org_name, su.oa_account manager_no, su.name_ch manager_name, su.name_ manager_mobile, su.oa_account actual_manager_no, su.name_ch actual_manager_name, su.name_ actual_manager_mobile, ctnr.nature_cust_id custom_id, to2.cust_name custom_name, CAST(CONCAT(IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(to2.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), ''), '.0') AS CHAR) as gmt_create, case to2.status_ when 'running' then NULL else DATE_FORMAT(to2.update_time ,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') end back_time, LEFT(to2.area_id , 4) as areaId,
b.ZB_BUILD_ID as buildId, b.BUILDING_NAME as buildName, 'GWJC' as category, DATE_FORMAT(b.exp_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as business_end_date
'' as buildId, '' as buildName, '' as category, '' as business_end_date
,ftcdw.CONTRACT_NAME AS contract_name, ftcdw.CONTRACT_ID AS contract_code, tc.cust_no, tc.cust_name
,w.svc_num
FROM topp_order to2 LEFT JOIN maintenance_detail md ON to2.id_ = md.order_id
JOIN ftp_tc_user_cust_warning c ON to2.info_id = c.id_ JOIN ( SELECT u.exp_time, w.BUILDING_NAME, w.ZB_BUILD_ID, w.MAIN_ORDER_FLOW_NO, w.id_ as warnUserId FROM wide_sys_auto_warning u JOIN ftp_tc_user_common_warning w ON w.id_=u.u_id WHERE IFNULL(u.IS_NINEDISCOUNT,0)=0 ) b ON b.MAIN_ORDER_FLOW_NO=c.MAIN_ORDER_FLOW_NO
LEFT JOIN ftp_tc_grp_contract_due_warning ftcdw ON to2.info_id = ftcdw.id_ LEFT JOIN tcomm_customer tc ON to2.cust_id = tc.id_
JOIN ftp_tc_user_cust_warning c ON to2.info_id = c.id_ JOIN ftp_tc_user_common_warning w ON w.MAIN_ORDER_FLOW_NO = c.MAIN_ORDER_FLOW_NO
JOIN sys_user su ON to2.creator_ = su.id_ JOIN sys_code sc ON to2.order_type = sc.code_ AND sc.type_='process_key' AND sc.setting_str3='maintenance_order'
LEFT JOIN cust_t_nec_relation ctnr ON md.cust_grp_id = ctnr.PROVINCE_CUST_ID
WHERE to2.order_type = #{orderType} AND to2.create_time >= '2024-01-01 00:00:00' AND to2.create_time <= CONCAT(#{yyMMdd}, ' 23:59:59')
